description: This PHP file defines the EmailQueueDao class, which handles database operations related to email queue management in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve, save, delete, and list email records based on their status.

classes.name: EmailQueueDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class responsible for managing email queue entities, including fetching, saving, deleting, and listing email entries in the database.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Retrieves an email entity by its ID from the database.

methods.name: saveEmail
methods.description: Persists an email entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: removeFromQueue
methods.description: Deletes multiple email entities from the queue based on an array of IDs.

methods.name: getAllPendingMailIds
methods.description: Fetches all IDs of emails that are pending in the queue.
